lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: Rangers don't answer to anyone. Must be freeing.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: We answer to the road. The road is a harder master than any captain.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: You run a tight formation for a man traveling without orders.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: You disagree with half my calls. You do it quietly. I respect that.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Loud disagreement wastes time. I'll tell you after.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: The Emberguard lost a lot of good people to the Veil.

lines.speaker: captain_maer
lines.text: Every good soldier who falls to them is a failure I carry.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Then carry lighter. Blame the Veil, not yourself.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Then we went badly together. Don't rehearse it.
